【Shooting Parameters】
Shot with a wide-angle lens at eye level, the camera is placed in the open space at the left front of the area, facing diagonally to the right front at about 45 degrees. No distortion, no people in the frame, presenting the wabi-sabi relaxed feeling and light and shadow layers of the space through a semi-enclosed composition.

【Overall Space Definition】
This space is the lobby corner reception area of a **wabi-sabi style private burger restaurant**. As the entrance transition and check-in display space of the restaurant, it has the functions of guest waiting, brand display and light rest, and can also be used as a characteristic visual node of the restaurant. With rough natural travertine, micro-cement and warm solid wood as the base, it creates a primitive, simple, relaxed and high-end private kitchen atmosphere, different from the homogenized design of fast food brands, conveying a niche and textured catering tone.

【Ceiling Details】
The ceiling is a warm beige matte micro-cement/art paint surface with a delicate texture and slight grain. There is no complex suspended ceiling shape, and the overall surface is flat and simple. A square warm light downlight/light panel is embedded in the center of the ceiling with a color temperature of 3000K, soft and non-glare, unified with the overall warm tone, no redundant decorations, maintaining the restraint of wabi-sabi style.

【Floor Details】
The floor is fully paved with dark gray matte antique stone slabs/cement tiles in large-size straight laying, with natural stone texture and slight color difference on the surface, heavy and stable texture. The tile surface is treated with low-reflective matte finish, which can softly reflect natural light and form a mottled light and shadow effect, forming a contrast with the warm tone of the ceiling. No debris accumulation, clean and tidy.

【Midground Details】
The midground of the frame is a semi-enclosed travertine partition and corner rest area:
1.  Partition Wall: Made of warm beige natural travertine, the wall retains the natural hole texture unique to travertine, with primitive and rough texture, forming a U-shaped semi-enclosed space with both privacy and display. The three-dimensional sign "汉堡私房菜" is embedded on the right side of the travertine wall, made of metal/wood texture, echoing the tone of the travertine, low-key and unobtrusive.
2.  Rest Corner: A set of simple furniture is placed in the travertine corner: a dark solid wood side table with a table lamp with off-white shade, an open menu/book, dark candlesticks and green plants on the table; a dark solid wood small stool is matched next to the side table, the overall layout is compact and relaxed without redundant design.

【Left Side Details】
The left side of the frame is a full floor-to-ceiling window with thin metal frame, transparent and clean glass, which can clearly see the outdoor green landscape (trees, grass). Natural light diffuses into the room through the glass, forming oblique mottled light and shadow on the travertine wall, strengthening the wabi-sabi atmosphere of the space; large green plants are placed by the window to soften the hard stone lines.

【Right Side Details】
The right side of the frame is an extended travertine wall, unified with the material and tone of the midground partition wall, maintaining the integrity of the space. The dining area inside the restaurant (dark tables and chairs) is faintly visible behind the wall. Through the semi-enclosed design, the natural transition between the lobby and the dining area is realized, which not only ensures the privacy of the corner area, but also does not affect the transparency of the space.

【Furniture Style & Color】
- Side Table: Dark solid wood material, simple and heavy shape, neat lines without redundant carvings;
- Table Lamp: Dark solid wood base + off-white fabric shade, warm texture, suitable for wabi-sabi style;
- Small Stool: Dark solid wood material, retro shape, unified with the side table style;
- The overall furniture is mainly dark wood color, with off-white and warm beige, stable and restrained tone, no bright colors.

【Lighting and Shadows】
The overall lighting is a combination of natural light and warm white artificial light with a color temperature of 3000K, soft and delicate light:
1.  Natural Light: The side light introduced by the floor-to-ceiling window on the left forms mottled light and shadow on the travertine wall, highlighting the texture of the travertine;
2.  Artificial Light: The embedded downlight on the ceiling provides uniform basic lighting, and the warm light of the table lamp creates a warm atmosphere for the corner area;
3.  Natural light and artificial light blend, with rich light and shadow layers and soft contrast, creating a primitive, simple, relaxed and high-end wabi-sabi catering atmosphere.
